name: Posters by Abracadabrax
original_description:
Give ChatGPT a headline and the key details, such as date, place or offer, and get a poster or flyer design with the text laid out on it, in portrait, square or landscape format.

The plugin prepares a draft with the kind of poster, the headline, the details to print, the visual theme and the image model, and shows the credits it will use. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the design and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For events, shops, clubs and venues.

Limitations: designs from text only. It does not place your own photos or logo files on the design, edit an existing poster file or print it. Producing uses credits of the user's Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
